name: EngineAI T800
summary: T800 is EngineAI's full-size humanoid, 1.73 m and 75 kg, with 29 body DoF and high-torque joints. It is offered in Base, Ecosystem, Pro and Max versions starting at 180,000 yuan and is aimed at industrial and commercial deployment.
hands: Biomimetic dexterous hands with tactile sensing and force control.

price.configuration: Base version; Ecosystem, Pro and Max versions cost more

highlights: Peak joint torque of 450 N·m and 14 kW peak joint power, per EngineAI.
Four tiers: Base, Ecosystem (open-source), Pro and Max.
caveats: Runtime of 4-5 hours is a company claim.
Little public data on paying industrial deployments.

sources.title: The Pinnacle of Humanoid Technology - The EngineAI T800 Is Officially Unveiled
